# OpenShot

> OpenShot is a free, open-source video editor providing tutorials and guides for learning video editing fundamentals.

OpenShot offers comprehensive learning resources for video editing, covering essential techniques like clip splitting, timeline editing, and project workflow. The platform is designed to make video editing accessible to users of all skill levels through step-by-step tutorials and guides.

## Key Topics

- video editing
- clip splitting
- timeline editing
- learning guides
- tutorials
- OpenShot editor
- open-source video
- non-linear editing

## Learning & Tutorials

- [Learn Video Editing with OpenShot](https://www.openshot.org/learn): Step-by-step tutorials and guides for learning video editing with OpenShot
